notes: Search, quantities, collection-list, health and sync-status ceilings retain the original compatibility suite's millisecond budgets, applied to repeated p95 samples.
Activity uses the same 400ms single-client ceiling as collection quantity lookups. Image delivery has a 1000ms ceiling while object writes are held behind a fixture barrier.
Concurrent database request ceilings are the single-client ceiling times the number of clients. Concurrent throughput must also retain at least half of measured serial throughput.
The existing 1.5 targeted-quantities comparison is retained using interleaved samples and medians, rather than two isolated requests.

The 512MiB Linux RSS ceiling is a provisional load-test guard for the 128MiB image cache plus bounded uploads, decoded fixture images, runtime and allocator overhead; it is not a production memory SLO.
Sync completion is bounded at 60 seconds for eight queued jobs against a one-page catalog and the frozen Cardmarket export. These are local capacity guards, not live-service SLAs.
